name: EPIC 220241308
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 7.2 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,283 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.83 solar masses and 7.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,737 K at its surface.
